author: sebek12345
quote: I absolutely hated this game.  It had its generic run and gun gameplay, which is what I came for, but two-thirds of the game is stupid quick time events, stealth, hand-to-hand combat - all done poorly.  I rarely rage quit games, but I sure rage quit this one.  If you came for the gunplay, this is the wrong game for you.
